CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DEP
AS 
BEGIN

--------------GET DELTA FROM BUSC
WITH TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct AS 
(
SELECT
	BDG.FORACID AS CustomerAccountId
	,BDG.ACCT_OPN_DATE AS PeriodStartDate
	,BDG.ACCT_CLS_DATE AS PeriodEndDate
	,BDG.SCHM_CODE AS ProductId
	,BDG.ACCT_CRNCY_CODE AS IsoCurrencyCode
	,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
	,NULL AS CommitmentId
	,BDG.SCHM_TYPE AS FcbsApplication
	,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
	,BDG.BANK_ID AS FinancialInstitutionId
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
	,BDG.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
    ,BDGD.RECORD_STATUS
FROM BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER_DELTA BDGD
LEFT JOIN BUSC.DEP_GENERALACCOUNTMASTER BDG ON BDGD.ACID = BDG.ACID AND BDGD.BANK_ID = BDG.BANK_ID AND BDG.ISLATEST = 1 
)
SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;

-------------CHECK IF THERE IS DELTA 
WITH
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FcbsApplication
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId, RECORD_STATUS 
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT
AS
(
SELECT
HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,FcbsApplication
,FinancialInstitutionId
)) HASHROW, CustomerAccountId
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct --WHERE SOURCE_CODE = 'DEP'	
)
,
TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA
AS
(
SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
	,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
	,CASE
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
	ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_TGT	TGT
ON	convert(varchar,SRC.CustomerAccountId) = convert(varchar,TGT.CustomerAccountId)
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)

SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

----UPDATE RECORDS to BNKM
UPDATE TGT 
SET
PeriodEndDate = SRC.PeriodStartDate
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct TGT
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId  AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId 
WHERE TGT.PeriodEndDate IS NULL

---INSERT RECORDS WITH UPDATE
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
 SRC.CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,SRC.ProductId AS ProductId
,SRC.IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,SRC.FcbsApplication AS FcbsApplication
,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
,SRC.FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,SRC.InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct SRC
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA DELTA ON  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE' AND DELTA.CustomerAccountId = SRC.CustomerAccountId

 


-------------INSERT RECORDS TO BNKM
INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ( 
CustomerAccountId
,PeriodStartDate
,PeriodEndDate
,ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode
,UsageCategoryId
,CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication
,SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm)

SELECT 
CustomerAccountId AS CustomerAccountId
,CONVERT(DATE,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PeriodStartDate)) AS PeriodStartDate
,NULL AS PeriodEndDate
,ProductId AS ProductId
,IsoCurrencyCode AS IsoCurrencyCode
,NULL AS UsageCategoryId
,NULL AS CommitmentId
,FcbsApplication AS FcbsApplication
,'DEP' AS SourceSystemCode
,FinancialInstitutionId AS FinancialInstitutionId
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,InsertDttm AS InsertDttm
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT') ;

DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CustomerAccountFinancialProduct_DELTA;

END
